title: MarinOS data/tech.json
description: Technology facts for every MarinOS app, written by scripts/tech.js. Apps are keyed by catalog.json id (MarinOS itself is "marin-os"). Languages, dependencies and the SBOM come from GitHub; bundled components come from the app's vendor/marinos/manifest.json and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md; AI comes from the `ai:` block in the app's own marin.yml and is declared, never inferred. Complete SBOMs are not duplicated here: they are stored as-is in data/sbom/<id>.spdx.json. A failed collection is never recorded as zero or "none": the part becomes status "unavailable" and keeps the last good result under lastSuccess. A missing AI declaration is status "not-documented" and is never treated as "used: false".

licenseNames.description: SPDX license id -> readable name (for example MIT -> MIT License), as GitHub's licenses API reports it. Ids GitHub does not know are absent and shown as they are.

kind.description: Present for shared building blocks (Marin App Shell, Marin UI) listed in tech-components.json; absent for apps.

name.description: Display name. Only on components; apps take theirs from catalog.json.

license.description: SPDX id from GitHub, or null when none is detected.

declaredRepo.description: project.repo from the app's marin.yml; must equal the app id.

percentages.description: Language bytes / total bytes x 100, one decimal. Only on success.

total.description: Packages other than the repository itself. 0 on success means GitHub found none; it never means failure.

packages.description: Packages in the SPDX file, including the repository itself.

services.description: Outside services the app itself uses, declared in marin.yml `services:`. `services: none` is documented with an empty list; a missing block is not-documented and is never treated as none. The App Shell's shared calls (recent changes from GitHub, MarinOS data files) are described by the shell, not listed here. Never contains credentials or secret names.

runs.description: browser: the visitor's browser calls it. build: only the build or a workflow calls it.

visitorData.description: Whether the service receives anything about the visitor.
